symptom: `create or modify published odata service` that adds `(KEY)` to a member already published without it reported 'Modified', `mxcli check` passed, and mxbuild refused it: CE0309 "Exposed attribute 'Email' of entity 'Customer' that is part of the key cannot be marked as 'Can be empty'"; a fresh `create` of the same statement built clean
cause: `carryPublishedEntityState` (#743) carries each member's stored CanBeEmpty by entity + member name, because MDL has no spelling for it. A non-key member is stored CanBeEmpty true; once it became a key, the carry wrote that true onto a key member instead of the derived `!IsPartOfKey`
insight: A carried value is valid only under the conditions it was stored in. When the statement CAN change one of its inputs (here the key status), the carry must be keyed on that input as well, or it turns a legitimate edit into an invalid model. The repro that settled it: same script, same project, old and new binary — CE0309 vs 0 errors. Plausible wrong turn: I first blamed the entity's NOT NULL change made between the runs, because that was the last thing I edited. The order of my own edits is not evidence; reading the carry was. Test: `TestModifyODataService_CanBeEmptyNotCarriedAcrossKeyChange` (with a control member whose key status is unchanged and still carries)
